title: Rabbi Chama, Father of Bar Kappara
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: So it is in Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot, chapter 6, halakhah 2, but Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be “Rabbi Chama, father of Rabbi Oshayah, and Bar Kappara.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 6:2 has Chama, father of Bar Kappara, alongside Oshaya. Hyman’s emendation reparses the fatherhood as applying to Oshayah and separates Bar Kappara; that remains his proposal rather than an admitted genealogy.

The whole Guggenheimer Shevuot 6:2 paragraph fully names Rabbi Chama, father of Bar Kappara, alongside Rabbi Hoshaya. These support the local full titles, while Hyman’s Oshayah form and his ‘scribal error/should read’ reattachment of fatherhood retain their force and attribution. The conjunction and father-of constructions remain distinct; no proposed genealogy is admitted.
